page.notes: Heavy smudging and dark strokes through the top lines (about lines 1 to 4 and 23 to 28) make several words doubtful; the marked words are the most uncertain. "Altarum" is read from a damaged word and may be "Altarium". The abbreviation "Seren:" and the name "Dave-nantii" are unclear. The "§ 63" marker is partly obscured. The text across the page has show-through and blotches, and the italic passages are inferred from the visible type. The catchword "volun-" and signature "H 2" are printed at the foot.
